lines.text: CostClaw. A local audit for Claude Code.
Your Anthropic invoice is one number. The waste hides in the session logs already on your disk.
One free command reads those logs on your machine, prices the recoverable spend, and ranks the fixes by the dollars they return.
Cache misses, model misrouting, sessions that outgrow the cache. Each priced, with evidence.
Then your setup gets a six pillar score, from evidence only. No evidence, no score.
And through all of it, your prompts and your code never leave your machine. A tripwire test keeps it that way.
Run the free audit: n p x costclaw audit. Free, no account, nothing uploaded.
